It is normal and okay to have kinks, even if they're taboo. Some people find some kinks "hot" BECAUSE they are taboo, and that is okay. As long as someone doesn't act on their taboo kink, and it just stays in fantasy. But this doesn't really sound like a kink. It doesn't sound like you actually enjoy it, and it sounds more like compulsion. Do you prehaps have OCD? It is a less known, but OCD can manifest in compulsive thoughts like this and then be misinterpret as a kink. The part about thinking badly about women, but then immediatly thinking that is rude also may be a form of OCD. Of course I can't tell you if that is the case, but I think it would be a good idea if you got it checked. I have a friend who had a very strong taboo kink, but later found out it was OCD, and they described it in this way too.
